label: Map edges examined and rejected in the round-5 worklist batch
summary: Map edges examined and rejected in the round-5 worklist batch. (1) Finitely many immediate predecessors from 'at most one direct cause per mode' (the shape of DEF-AT-MOST-ONE-IMMEDIATE-CAUSE) with the four-mode classification: valid but strictly stronger than needed and false for concurring agents; finitely many per mode (STMT-FINITELY-MANY-CAUSES-PER-MODE) suffices. (2) Well-founded predecessors from finite ancestry, no loops and finite branching (FiniteBranching.wellFounded_iff_finiteAncestry_and_noLoops): valid, but finite ancestry is itself derived from well-foundedness (CAUSAL-FINITE-BRANCHING-TO-FINITE-ANCESTRY), so the route is circular for closure. (3) No loops from well-founded predecessors alone: valid (a well-founded transitive closure is irreflexive) but it relocates the weaker condition to a strictly stronger open premise; the priority route uses existing secunda via statements instead. (4) Pure act operates from 'whatever is in act in some respect and moved in no respect operates from itself': a stone at rest (in act in being, presently moved in no respect) would operate from itself; replaced by operation following being in act plus the self-or-moved dichotomy, which leaves the stone case to the open dichotomy premise. (5) Intellect has an intelligible form from STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL: it yields intellect, not an actual intelligible form; the power/act gap would need the same understands-something premise. Rejection records that a lead was examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
